name: Scanner
description: AI agents are reshaping how security teams investigate threats, and they need a radically different kind of data layer to do it. Scanner indexes security logs directly in S3, making petabytes of data searchable in seconds at a fraction of traditional SIEM costs. Customers including Notion, Ramp and BeyondTrust use Scanner to run detections across years of data. AI agents now execute over 80% of queries on the platform.
